CSCA Mathematics: Exam Format and Practice

Learn how the 48-question CSCA Mathematics paper works, check the four topic areas, and try a free five-question practice set.

CSCA.ai Editorial Team

What is the CSCA Mathematics paper?

CSCA Mathematics has 48 single-answer questions in 60 minutes, is scored from 0 to 100, and is offered in English or Chinese. The official 2025 syllabus lists four areas: sets and inequalities, functions, geometry and algebra, and probability and statistics.

For undergraduate programs that require the CSCA, Mathematics is the common paper across majors, including business and humanities. Confirm whether your target university requires the exam, which language it accepts, and its application deadline in the current admission notice.

Check the official CSCA exam introduction and your target university's current admission notice before choosing papers.

CSCA exam topics

The official paper covers four areas of school-level mathematics.

Topic summary last checked 14 October 2026. Use the current CSCA syllabus as your final checklist. Our subject overview helps you compare papers before you practise.

Sets and inequalities

Set operations, representations, and methods for solving quadratic and rational inequalities.

Functions and sequences

Function properties, elementary functions, arithmetic and geometric sequences, and basic derivatives.

Geometry and algebra

Lines and conics, vectors, complex numbers, coordinate geometry, and simple solid geometry.

Probability and statistics

Classical probability, data measures such as mean and variance, and basic normal distribution ideas.

Print a Mathematics study checklist

Use this one-page worksheet to mark the topics you can solve without notes, plan a seven-day review, and move into timed practice. It is an independent study aid based on the official Mathematics syllabus, not an official paper or a past paper.
